questions.question: What is the normal effect of the corpus striatum on muscle tone?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C. It inhibits muscle tone

questions.question: Which of the following neurotransmitter particularly associated with Parkinson's syndrome ?
A lesion of the basal ganglia typically causes:
options: Disturbances of muscle tone and involuntary movements
Complete loss of tendon reflex arcs
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Disturbances of muscle tone and involuntary movements
